title: Chapter 1353
text:
The interception work was still in full swing. Because the opponent only brought one Holy Tree Emissary, the other intercepting troops did not encounter any individual strength, only Kasuyi was dispatched once. The other Beyond Grade As did not have the chance to make a move and were on standby at the main base of the interception zone.

In the cubicle of the command room, nearly a hundred Beyond Grade As were gathered together, doing their own things. Some were supervising the situation, some were resting with their eyes closed, some were handling matters, some were chatting casually, and some were even playing cards on such a serious occasion. It was simply unreasonable.

"Speaking of which, it's been a while since our two groups sat down and chatted together."

Kant looked at the direct descendants of the three Universal Civilizations who were sitting upright and said with a sigh.

When the three Universal Civilizations targeted the association, Han Xiao did not allow the direct Beyond Grade As to participate in the regular meeting. After the lockdown was lifted, due to various matters, they had not restored the normal treatment of the direct descendants of the three Universal Civilizations in the association. Therefore, when they were on standby at the main base, it was a situation where the association members and the direct Beyond Grade As sat together and chatted.

"Now that we're all facing a common enemy, let's not talk about the past for the time being. We're just doing it for our own masters." Oulou sighed and glanced at Han Xiao, who was in a daze (browsing the forums), with a complicated expression.

"Heh, don't confuse us with you. You have masters, but we don't. It's all for ourselves." Sun Hunter curled his lips.

Oulou was silent for a few seconds before changing the topic. "I see that not all the members of your association are here. Why aren't the others here?"

"They're still considering." Kasuyi shook his head.

"You guys are participating in the battle, and they're just watching from the back? You guys can accept this? "Oulou raised his brows.

"That's why you guys should kneel down and be grateful to us … Damn it, just thinking about it makes me feel so great," Sun Hunter cursed.

Kasuyi explained helplessly, "Someone has to set an example. If not for Black Star taking the lead, we might not have come."

At this moment, Clottey, who was resting with his eyes closed, opened his eyes and slowly said,

"Then, do you guys have the resolve to die in battle?"

Hearing this, everyone paused and turned to look.

Clottey was expressionless and calm.

"We, the direct descendants, have entered the battle with the determination to sacrifice our lives. Aren't you selfish people afraid of losing your lives? Even if there's a Sanctum Revival, I'm sure none of you are willing to spend a chance to revive and hand over the initiative of life to others. "

"… You're right. Of course no one is willing to sacrifice themselves if they can live. However, we need to personally experience the strength of the enemy in order to know what's going on. So, don't expect us to fight to the death for you. We're just fulfilling our end of the deal. We've already done our best to help you."

Secret Master responded indifferently.

At that moment, Oulou looked at Han Xiao, who wasn't participating in the conversation, and said loudly,

"Black Star, if we die, you will help us revive, right?"

Hearing this, Han Xiao turned around and glanced at him, giving him a concise reply.

He wasn't familiar with Oulou before, but after interacting with him for a few days, he found him to be as easy to deal with as the others said.

"Yes."

"Ha, then I'm relieved. If I can leave my body behind when I die in battle, please make a specimen out of the Spacetime Amber and let me bring it away after I revive, lest others covet my handsomeness and steal my body home."

Oulou made a joke, but no one laughed.

"Do you think you're very humorous?"

Sun Hunter rolled his eyes.

Han Xiao couldn't be bothered with the people chatting. He looked away and continued to browse the forums.

Currently, more than ninety percent of the players in the universe had come to the frontlines. Most of them were rubbing their hands, looking forward to the war starting soon.

Such large-scale war operations had always been a good opportunity for the players to gain experience. Most of the army players participating in the operation could gain experience more efficiently, which was beneficial for Han Xiao to accumulate experience.

However, the players had not reached the level limit of the version, so the best use of experience was to level up on their own. Only after reaching the level limit would they have a lot of excess experience to do other things.

This meant that when most of the players reached the maximum level, his efficiency of harvesting experience would increase by a lot. Now was not the fastest time to harvest experience.

It's a pity that the role of the players can't reach the level of my previous life …

Han Xiaoxin was speechless.

The World Tree War was originally a late version, but due to the butterfly effect, it had been brought forward to Version 5.0. In his previous life, it was only a mid-version. The players had lost a few versions of accumulation, and the level limit was reduced by dozens of levels. Naturally, their role on the battlefield was not as good as in his previous life.

In his previous life, the players had a very high strategic value. The Immortal Death Squad formed by high-level Supers had made a lot of contributions in many local battlefields. Now that this force was gone, it would definitely affect all aspects.

Fortunately, the fate of Hella and her sister had been rewritten by him. The Underworld should be able to fill this gap.

Beep beep beep …

Just as he was thinking, his communicator suddenly rang. It was a message from Oathkeeper.

Han Xiao took it out and took a look. His expression changed slightly, and he said with a deep voice,

"The World Tree is recruiting an army. It's estimated to be tens of billions. It's preparing to launch a strong attack!"

Hearing this, the chatter in the room disappeared. Everyone stopped what they were doing and turned to look over. Their expressions were solemn, surprised, and fearful.

Han Xiao immediately walked out of the cubicle and shared the information with Simon and the others. The other Beyond Grade As also stood up and followed behind Han Xiao.

Simon and the other commanders had been supervising the entire situation outside the cubicle. When they heard the information Han Xiao shared, their expressions changed. They hurriedly opened the long-distance communication and reported the situation to the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations.

The figures of the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations appeared on the long-distance communication screen. The three of them listened to the report with solemn expressions and nodded solemnly.

"Is the World Tree Civilization preparing to attack? Got it. We will send the order for the various armies to gather at the frontlines and prepare for a tough battle. "

As he spoke, Marbruce exhaled, and his tone carried a hint of relief.

"Black Star, your news this time is still very timely. You've bought us a lot of time."

The World Tree Civilization was still in the recruitment phase, and before they could gather their fleet, they were detected by Destiny's Child and sent to Han Xiao. This was a huge advantage. The other party would not attack so quickly, so they had plenty of time to prepare.

If they knew the other party's next move in advance, the three Universal Civilizations would be able to react in advance. Black Star's intelligence channel had made contributions more than once, but every time, the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations would feel that he had helped them in their hour of need.

"It's not easy to deal with a fleet of tens of billions. Although I provided the advantage of intelligence, you guys are the main force."

Han Xiao nodded.

The World Tree Civilization had sent out tens of billions of battleships, which was indeed not a small force. However, in the scale of a universal war, this was not considered a general attack. The scale of tens of billions of battleships was not at the level where they were invincible.

The mobilization ability of internal and external battles could not be compared. When there were no external enemies, the three Universal Civilizations would control their military strength to an appropriate standard and would not expand their army on a large scale to avoid excessive military expenditure. They would mainly store strategic resources. Once they fully entered the state of war industry, they would quickly turn into a militaristic mode. All the military factories under them would be filled with soldiers day and night, and their military strength would increase every day.

The scale of the World Tree's attack was not enough for the three Universal Civilizations to immediately give up on intercepting them. Unless they could not stop them at all, it was not the time to use the strategic rear to exchange for time.

This time, a staff officer stroked his chin and said, "Since the other party is still in the process of recruiting troops, should we try to take the initiative to attack and harass them?"

Hearing this, everyone turned to look at him before retracting their gazes.

Simon glanced at him, shook his head, and said, "The World Tree's Information Form warning network covers the entire territory. If we encounter it, we'll be exposed. What can we harass? Furthermore, any army can travel quickly through the territory, almost teleporting. Their mobility is far from what we can compare to. It's a natural ambush circle. Once we're exposed, we'll be surrounded by countless fleets. No matter how many of us go, we'll be eaten. "

Another commander pulled the topic back on track and said with a deep voice, "The wormhole rapid support base station has already covered the current intercepting circle. No matter which intercepting area the World Tree hits, we can start a positional battle and stop the other party from breaking through."

The intercepting circle was divided into many levels, and there were strategic areas of different distances between the different levels. The rapid support base station was a connecting channel, ensuring that the troops in the various areas would look after each other. Both the observation layer and the garrison layer had completed the relevant configuration. No matter where they encountered a strong enemy, they could quickly send in their main forces.

As for whether the World Tree's assault troops would hit the intercepting circle, it was not a big problem. Although the intercepting circle was still under construction, it did not need to be fully formed to be effective. In essence, it was very similar to a race. It just needed to expand faster than the enemy. At the same time, the intercepting troops were also constantly setting up space anchoring orbits to clear the coordinates of the exploration teams, causing the opponent's starting point to move back as much as possible. As a result, they could only continue to travel normally and remain in the intercepting circle.

"It seems like the World Tree doesn't plan to just give us an appetizer. It's going to give us a main course … This is the first time I've experienced a universal war of this scale."

Oulou's eyes flickered.

At this moment, Secret Master pinched his fingers and did a divination. He then said expressionlessly, "My Death Omen is flashing."

With that, his hand gesture changed, and magic waves spread out.

Everyone sensed something and looked over curiously.

"What did you do just now?"

"I transferred the bad luck," Secret Master said calmly.

"Who did you transfer it to?"

"Him."

Secret Master pointed at Han Xiao.

Han Xiao looked at the luck reduction status on the interface, and his face was full of question marks.

"Do we have a grudge?"

"No."

"Then why did you transfer the bad luck to me?"

"Anyway, you're not afraid. There's no room for your luck to decrease."

"…"

The corners of Han Xiao's mouth twitched.

Do you think I'm a trash can? If not for the fact that there are external enemies, I would have immediately let you know why your chrysanthemum is yellow.
